name: 2026-09-18 multi-sport pregame capture
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/nfl-det-buf-learning-audit-20260918]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/pregame-20260918.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  capture:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.12'}
      - name: Run health first
        run: |
          mkdir -p pregame
          set +e
          timeout 120 python -u harness/healthcheck.py > pregame/health.txt 2>&1
          echo $? > pregame/health.exit
          set -e
      - name: Capture dated schedules and source bytes
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import urllib.request,pathlib,json,hashlib,datetime,concurrent.futures
          root=pathlib.Path('pregame');src=root/'sources';src.mkdir()
          urls={
          'mlb_schedule.json':'https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule?sportId=1&date=2026-09-18&hydrate=probablePitcher,venue',
          'wnba_scoreboard.json':'https://cdn.nba.com/static/json/liveData/scoreboard/todaysScoreboard_00.json',
          'cfb_scoreboard.json':'https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/college-football/scoreboard?dates=20260918&limit=100',
          'mls_scoreboard.json':'https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/soccer/usa.1/scoreboard?dates=20260918&limit=100',
          'nfl_scoreboard.json':'https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard?dates=20260918&limit=100'}
          def get(x):
            name,url=x;r={'filename':name,'url':url,'started':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
            try:
              req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'sports-model research'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=60) as q:b=q.read()
              (src/name).write_bytes(b);r.update(status='captured',retrieved_at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),bytes=len(b))
            except Exception as e:r.update(status='failed',error=repr(e))
            return r
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as p:receipts=list(p.map(get,urls.items()))
          (root/'receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2))
          (root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2))
          PY
      - name: Inventory model readiness without inventing forecasts
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import pathlib,json,datetime,subprocess,os
          root=pathlib.Path('pregame');src=root/'sources'
          out={'created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'date':'2026-09-18','commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'leagues':{}}
          def espn(name,file):
            p=src/file
            if not p.exists():return {'source_status':'failed','events':[]}
            j=json.loads(p.read_text());return {'source_status':'captured','events':[{'id':e.get('id'),'name':e.get('name'),'date':e.get('date'),'status':e.get('status',{}).get('type',{}).get('name')} for e in j.get('events',[])]}
          out['leagues']['NFL']=espn('NFL','nfl_scoreboard.json')
          out['leagues']['CFB']=espn('CFB','cfb_scoreboard.json')
          out['leagues']['MLS']=espn('MLS','mls_scoreboard.json')
          p=src/'mlb_schedule.json'
          if p.exists():
            j=json.loads(p.read_text());out['leagues']['MLB']={'source_status':'captured','events':[{'gamePk':g['gamePk'],'date':g['gameDate'],'away':g['teams']['away']['team']['name'],'home':g['teams']['home']['team']['name'],'status':g['status']['abstractGameState'],'away_probable':g['teams']['away'].get('probablePitcher',{}).get('fullName'),'home_probable':g['teams']['home'].get('probablePitcher',{}).get('fullName')} for d in j.get('dates',[]) for g in d.get('games',[])]}
          else:out['leagues']['MLB']={'source_status':'failed','events':[]}
          # WNBA dated endpoint above may not be date-addressable: do not infer slate from it.
          out['leagues']['WNBA']={'source_status':'captured_unverified_date' if (src/'wnba_scoreboard.json').exists() else 'failed','events':[]}
          for league in ['NBA','NHL']:out['leagues'][league]={'source_status':'not_captured','events':[]}
          (root/'inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pregame-20260918-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: pregame
          retention-days: 90
